jobs.title: Commercial BEST IT Program Manager

Commercial BEST IT Program Manager NA SAPMENA.
Location:   Shanghai
Department: O+O Zone IT
Reporting to: Head of Commercial IT, NA SAPMENA
Key Collaboration Partners: Zone & Market Commercial Transformation Teams, India Tech Hub (ITH), Market commercial and finance teams.
Mission & Role Overview
Based in Shanghai, the Commercial  BEST IT Program Manager is a strategic leadership role. You will be the primary architect and orchestrator of the BEST Program for the Commercial IT domain across the APAC zone. The BEST program is a major strategic initiative putting key business resources into our India Tech Hub (ITH) to operate as a dedicated, business captive starting with Business planning followed by other commercial process areas.
In this role, you will not just manage execution, you will drive the strategy, align regional roadmaps, define timelines, and take full ownership of budget tracking . Working in lockstep with the Commercial Transformation Teams and Zone leadership, you will act as the key pivot point between strategic decisions, market-level commercial needs, and the delivery capability in the ITH captive. Your mission is to maximize the business value of our commercial applications, including Business Process Management (BPM), Sales Force Automation (SFA), Distributor Management Systems (DMS), and by effectively leveraging this new business-captive delivery model.
Key Responsibilities
1. Drive Commercial Strategy & Roadmap Alignment
- Strategic Leadership: Drive the long-term technological and operational strategy for Zone Commercial IT, positioning the BEST business-captive program as a core accelerator of business growth.
- Roadmap & Timeline Ownership: Consolidate and align disparate market requirements into a single, cohesive Zone roadmap. Establish, negotiate, and enforce realistic timelines for major rollouts (such as SFA, DMS, and BPM applications).
- Dependency & Risk Management: Proactively identify and resolve roadmap dependencies and resource conflicts between NA SAPMENA markets and the ITH delivery teams to guarantee seamless deployments.

2. Rigorous Financial & Budget Tracking
- Financial Stewardship: Own the end-to-end budget tracking (CAPEX and OPEX) for the Commercial BEST related program and associated application rollouts.
- Cost-Benefit & ROI Analysis: Monitor, analyze, and report on the financial efficiency of the business-captive model. Ensure IT solutions delivers the targeted financial optimization and return on investment (ROI) for our businesses.
- Resource Costing: Manage and forecast resource allocation costs, balancing budget constraints with market demands and program delivery speeds.

3. BEST Program Governance & Organizational Design
- Captive Operating Model: Define and govern the operational framework that allows commercial business resources in the ITH captive to seamlessly integrate with technical delivery squads.
- Commercial Transformation Partnership: Partner deeply with regional and local Commercial Transformation Teams to ensure the IT solutions are directly addressing market pain points and driving efficiency.
- High-Level Governance: Establish and lead SteerCos and operational review meetings with senior business and IT stakeholders to report on program health, timeline adherence, and budget consumption.

4. Stakeholder Navigation & Change Management
- Senior Stakeholder Management: Act as the trusted advisor to Market Tech Leads, Local market commercial business stakeholders, and Zone Business Owners, translating complex technical architectures into strategic business outcomes.
- Change Leadership: Champion the cultural shift required to run a blended business-and-tech captive model, maintaining high trust and collaboration between Zone, local markets, and ITH.

-

Technical & Domain Requirements

- Commercial Domain Expertise: Strong strategic understanding of BPM (Business Planning/Process Management) platforms, SFA (Sales Force Automation) and DMS (Distributor Management Systems), and
- Financial Acumen: Advanced experience in IT budget tracking, financial forecasting, and high value program portfolios.
- Operating Model Design: Proven track record of managing or setting up global delivery hub models, shared services, or in-house captives (ideally transitioning business roles into a tech-centric captive structure).
- Methodology: Mastery of Agile program management at scale (Scrum, Kanban) and structured Change Management frameworks.

Soft Skills & Competencies
- Strategic Visionary: Ability to connect long-term organizational transformation with day-to-day timeline execution and P&L impact.
- Influencing & Negotiation: Outstanding capability to negotiate timelines and align roadmaps across multiple markets with competing priorities.
- Analytical Problem Solving: Highly data-driven, comfortable navigating complex budget sheets and resource capacity models.
- Excellent Communication: Exceptional presentation skills, comfortable presenting roadmaps, financial health, and strategic pivots to Executive Committees and Zone leaders.

Experience & Qualifications
Required Experience
- Professional Experience: 10+ years of experience in IT Program Management, Business Transformation, or IT Consulting, with a strong focus on Commercial/Sales technologies.
- Industry Background: Proven experience in FMCG, Retail, or Consumer Goods sectors is highly preferred, with a deep understanding of route-to-market strategies and distributor networks.
- Captive/Hub Operations: Hands-on experience working with or establishing global shared services, offshore delivery hubs, or business-captive operations (specifically managing transitions of IT capabilities to centralized hubs).
- Track Record in Commercial Tech: Successful history of delivering large-scale, multi-market rollouts for SFA (Sales Force Automation/Salesforce), DMS (Distributor Management Systems), and BPM solutions across APAC (Anaplan experience can be added advantage).
- Financial Stewardship: Demonstrable experience owning, tracking, and optimizing complex IT budgets with strict adherence to corporate governance.

Education & Professional Certifications
- Education: Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, or a related field.
- Project Management Certifications: PMP (Project Management Professional), PgMP (Program Management Professional), or equivalent credentials.
- Agile Certifications: Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), or Agile Project Management (PMI-ACP) certifications are highly valued.
- Change Management: Prosci or equivalent Change Management certification is a strong advantage given the organizational redesign aspects of the BEST program.

Success Metrics (KPIs)
- Roadmap & Timeline Adherence: On-time delivery of SFA, DMS, and BPM regional milestones according to the aligned Zone roadmap.
- Budget Precision: Management of CAPEX/OPEX budgets within a +/- 5% variance, demonstrating strict cost control and optimized resource allocation.
- Captive Maturity & Speed: Significant improvement in application delivery velocity and market adoption rates driven by the integrated ITH business captive.
- Stakeholder Satisfaction: Strong alignment and high feedback scores from both the Zone Commercial Transformation Teams and local market business leaders.

Who is L’Oréal?
L'Oréal is the world's largest and most profitable beauty company. Present in over 150 countries, L’Oréal has catered to all forms of beauty in the world for over 100 years and has built an unrivalled portfolio of more than 36 international, diverse and complementary brands including L'Oréal Paris, Garnier, Maybelline New York, Nyx Professional Makeup, IT Cosmetics, Lancôme, Kiehl's, Urban Decay, Shu Uemura, Giorgio Armani, Yves Saint Laurent Beauté, Ralph Lauren, Diesel, Biotherm, Clarisonic, Kérastase, L'Oréal Professionnel, Matrix, Vichy, and La Roche-Posay.
For more than a century, L’Oréal has devoted itself solely to one business: beauty . The group's mission is to provide the best in cosmetics innovation to women and men around the world with respect for their diversity. We want to bring beauty to all people. Our ambition for the coming years is to win over another one billion consumers around the world by creating the cosmetic products that meet the infinite diversity of their beauty needs and desires.
Our business is energetic and vibrant, underpinned by strong ethical principles and our belief that financial performance and responsible business go hand-in-hand. We are driven each day by our six founding values - Passion, Innovation, Entrepreneurial Spirit, Open-mindedness, Quest for Excellence and Responsibility.

The distance between beauty and tech is closing rapidly, and we are determined to be pioneers in this new beauty tech world. New digital technologies and services are making the world of beauty move faster than ever before. Data and artificial intelligence are opening new horizons for personalization and customization. By incorporating digital into everything that we do, we are creating a better relationship with our consumers.

When beauty and tech collide, the impossible can happen!

In our journey, we are looking for talented individuals who can lead us on this mission.

Would you like to be a part of the adventure?

Why join us?

Being the world's #1 beauty company, L'Oréal empowers its people who are ready to take bets, think out of the box, defend their convictions, be resilient and leave their own mark. They are offered numerous opportunities, fast track careers and early responsibilities. L'Oréal has ambitious goals and is striving for excellence. This permanent learning experience helps you stretch your potential.
We define success as making a positive, conscious impact. At L’Oréal, you will be encouraged to think and act beyond your job. We push boundaries and move fast globally to stay ahead of the game. Your job will be your own innovation playground. We encourage different points of view. What sets you apart is what makes you great. You will always have the space to question, express, agree and disagree. We unleash everyone's potential. Here, learning opportunities are endless. You will build your own unique path. We believe in the impact of great mentors. You will be inspired by people you won't ever want to forget.

What will you do?
We are seeking a BPO (Business Process Outsourcing) Vendor Service Delivery Manager to oversee the successful delivery of services provided by our BPO vendor. The Service Delivery Manager will be responsible for managing the relationship with our BPO vendor, ensuring service level agreements (SLAs) are met, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. This role requires strong leadership, excellent communication skills, and a deep understanding of both L’Oreal & BPO operations.
Responsibilities:
- Manage the relationship with our BPO vendor, serving as the primary point of contact for all service-related matters.
- Collaborate with internal stakeholders to define and document service requirements, ensuring alignment with business objectives.
- Ensure that vendor performance meets or exceeds agreed-upon SLAs a nd Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
- Conduct regular performance reviews with vendors, providing feedback and guidance to drive improvements.
- Co-create & review Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) documents to ensure it is up to date & accurate

Job Title: Demand & Supply Chain Manager
Location:  Woodmead, Johannesburg
Reporting to:  Head of Supply & Network Planning

Role Purpose
The Demand & Supply Chain Manager is responsible for the synchronisation of the entire value chain. This role oversees the statistical forecasting of consumer demand and translates those insights into a seamless supply plan. In South Africa, this involves navigating a volatile currency (ZAR), managing complex import timelines, and ensuring product availability across a vast geographical landscape to service both major retailers and growing e-commerce channels.

Key Responsibilities
1. Demand Planning & S&OP Leadership
- Statistical Forecasting: Lead the monthly demand planning cycle, using historical data and market intelligence to create a baseline forecast.
-   S&OP Facilitation: Chair the Sales & Operations Planning meetings, acting as the neutral arbiter between Marketing’s ambitions, Sales’ targets, and Finance’s budgets.
-   Promotional Planning: Specifically manage 'Peak Periods' unique to the SA retail calendar, such as Black Friday, Back-to-School, and the festive season, ensuring stock builds are timed correctly.
- New Product Introductions (NPI): Coordinate with Brand Managers to forecast demand for new launches, ensuring 'Pipe Fill' reaches stores like Clicks, Dis-Chem, or Woolworths and others on time.

2. Supply Planning & Inventory Optimization
-    Replenishment Strategy: Convert the demand forecast into supply requirements, managing orders with international factories or local contract manufacturers.
-   Inventory Health: Monitor Stock on Hand (SOH) and manage 'Slow Moving and Obsolete Stock' (SLOBs) to protect the balance sheet.
-   Lead Time Management: Factor in the specific lead times for South Africa, including sea freight durations to Durban or Cape Town and potential port congestion delays.

3. Logistics, Distribution & Local Context
- 3PL Management: Oversee the performance of local warehousing and transport partners, ensuring high 'On-Time In-Full' (OTIF) delivery rates.
-   Risk Mitigation: Develop strategies to maintain supply continuity during South African-specific challenges, such as load shedding (impacting warehouse automation/cold chain) or transport strikes.

Requirements: Experience & Skills
-   Educational Background: A University Degree in Supply Chain, Commerce, or Statistics. A post-graduate qualification (Honours/Masters) is preferred.
-   Professional Experience: 7–10 years in a supply chain environment, with at least 3 years specifically in Demand Planning/Forecasting. Experience in the FMCG, Cosmetics, or Pharmaceutical sectors is highly valued.

Systems Expertise:
-   Advanced proficiency in SAP (or similar ERP) and specialized Demand Planning software (e.g., FuturMaster, APO, or Anaplan).
- Expert-level Excel skills for complex data modeling.
- Analytical Mindset: The ability to find the 'story' behind the numbers—understanding why a specific region in the Eastern Cape is underperforming or why a certain product line is spiking in Gauteng.
- Communication: Strong negotiation skills to manage the tension between Sales (who want more stock) and Finance (who want less inventory).

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
-   Forecast Accuracy (FA): Measuring the variance between planned demand and actual sales.
- Bias: Ensuring the forecast isn't consistently too high or too low.
-   Inventory Days/Weeks of Cover: Maintaining lean stock levels without risking out-of-stocks.
- Service Level (OTIF): Ensuring the end customer (Retailer or Consumer) receives their order perfectly.
-    Total Landed Cost: Monitoring the cost of getting goods from the factory to the South African shelf.

Why Join L'Oréal South Africa?
At L'Oréal, we offer a dynamic environment where innovation meets operational excellence. As a Customer Care Co-ordinator, you are not just managing orders; you are ensuring that our world-class beauty products reach our consumers, fulfilling our purpose to 'Create the beauty that moves the world.

We do not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion or other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, marital status, medical condition or disability. We adhere to all local Labour Relations legislation.
